function.description: run a shell command in the background. You will be notified automatically when it finishes.
function.name: job

command.description: the command line (for action 'start'); if omitted, re-runs previous job by name

name.description: the job name; 1–10 characters from [a-z0-9-] (for all actions except 'list', 'prune')

names.description: the job names to watch for wait

wait_for.description: whether wait returns after any or all watched jobs end

wait_seconds.description: how many seconds to wait at most — max 270 (default)

messages.content: Job names use one to ten lowercase letters, digits, or hyphens.
